notes:
{明|あき}らか is a na-adjective meaning obvious, clear, or evident.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {明|あき}らかな + noun
- Adverb: {明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (clearly, obviously)
- Verb form: {明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clarify, to make clear)
- Verb form: {明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become clear)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {明|あき}らかな⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: an obvious fact
- {明|あき}らかな⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧: clear evidence
- {明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: clearly different
- {明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧: obviously wrong
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clarify the cause
- ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あき}らか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the truth becomes clear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧: clear, definite (more formal)
- ⟦{明白|めいはく}→明白：14956_meihaku⟧: obvious, evident (formal, literary)
- ⟦{歴然|れきぜん}→歴然：noentry⟧: evident, unmistakable
- ⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧: clearly (adverb, casual)
- ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧: certain, sure

WRITING:
The kanji {明|あき} means 'bright' or 'clear.' Related words include ⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧ (bright), ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ (explanation), and ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧ (proof).

USAGE:
{明|あき}らか is commonly used in both spoken and written Japanese to state that something is obviously true or evident.
